the CNT film based composite cathodes with a conductive network and intercrossing micro channels could be used as an efficient cathode in potassium sulfur batteries.
the CNT/S composite cathode with high initial capacity and stable cycling performance is developed.

the development of novel CNT film based composite cathodes for high energy potassium sulfur batteries.
the design of high performance and low cost potassium ion batteries (KIBs) for large scale energy storage applications.
the development of a free standing carbon nanotubes/sulfur composite electrode as a high capacity cathode for potassium sulfur (K–S) batteries.
